meta.name: add-teams
meta.description: Add Microsoft Teams channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 集成 Microsoft Teams 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Teams 消息通知功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Teams messaging to your application

howto.what: 这个技能会为你的 AI 助手安装并配置 Microsoft Teams 适配器,完成后助手就能在 Teams 的频道、群聊和私聊中接收和回复消息。
howto.when: 当你要求把 AI 助手接入 Microsoft Teams(例如提到“添加 Teams”、“配置 Teams 机器人”等)时,这个技能会开始执行。

say.text: 帮我的助手接入 Microsoft Teams,我要在 Teams 里和它聊天。
say.note: 开始复制适配器并引导你完成 Teams 机器人配置。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 添加 Teams 支持吧。
say.note: 会检查现有凭据,然后安装并注册 Teams 通道。

say.text: 我想在 Teams 私聊里收到助手消息,请配置一下。
say.note: 技能会创建或复用机器人,并把你设为接收人。

howto.what_en: Installs and registers the Microsoft Teams adapter, so the assistant can receive and reply to messages in Teams channels, group chats, and direct messages.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to connect the assistant to Microsoft Teams, e.g. mentioning 'add Teams', 'configure Teams bot', etc.

say_en.text: Connect my assistant to Microsoft Teams so I can chat with it there.
say_en.note: Starts copying the adapter and guiding Teams bot setup.
Checks credentials and installs/registers the Teams channel.

say_en.text: I want to receive assistant messages in Teams DMs, please set it up.
say_en.note: Creates or reuses the bot and wires you as the recipient.
